verdict.rationale: Cal.com is a scheduling platform, so automatically protecting focus time is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack documents no feature that auto-defends recurring focus or habit blocks or moves them when conflicts appear. Availability schedules, recurring bookings and the manual reschedule API are adjacent building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, the product auto-defends recurring focus time and habits, flexibly moving them when conflicts appear instead of dropping them
